pkgmetadata.longdescription: Audiobook Forge converts audiobook directories to a single M4B file with chapter markers and embedded metadata. It orchestrates FFmpeg (audio processing), MP4Box from media-video/gpac (chapter injection) and AtomicParsley from media-video/atomicparsley-wez (metadata injection), and can pull chapter data from CUE sheets, EPUB files or the Audnex API.
